business_summary: Shanghai Rongtai Health Technology Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, design, production, and sale of massage equipment under the Rongtai and Momoda brands in China and internationally. The company offers massage chairs and accessories, experiential massage services, and other products; ankle revive, ROVO walking, and small massagers; shared massage services; and smart home health gadgets, including slimming machines and beauty devices, as well as purchase and after-sale services. It is also involved in software and financial; technology promotion and application; investment and asset management; and wholesale and retail trade activities. In addition, the company engages in the e-commerce business and online sales; sale of smart home consumer devices and artificial intelligence hardware; and research, development, manufacturing, and sales of automatic coffee machines. The company sells its products through distributors, direct sales, e-commerce, experience stores, ODM, shopping mall terminals, and chain stores. It exports its products. Shanghai Rongtai Health Technology Corporation Limited was founded in 1997 and is based in Shanghai, China.
